method: Fresh mechanics_notes-plus-notes frontier census over the 474-record canonical dataset, excluding records with registered current-evidence audit artifacts. The four shortest remaining unaudited records were selected and rechecked against current skill-specific references and independent corroboration.
evidence_boundaries: Exact frame data is not promoted.
Patch-independent damage/scaling is not inferred from historical or community reports.
Documented source conflicts are preserved rather than silently normalized.
Exact drop probabilities, hidden conditions, and unresolved combo coverage remain unresolved unless directly evidenced.
